stopper_list: Swedish aktiebolag operating in Sweden (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)
No profit distributed in the latest financial year (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)
Not listed, company or whole group (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)
Net turnover or balance-sheet total max SEK 10m last FY, one may exceed but not both, whole group (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)
Max 10 employees as FTE (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)
Not granted funding in Innovativa Startups 2025 (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)
Max 10 years old at decision date 2027-03-23 from Bolagsverket registration (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)
Not taken over a business, bought a company or formed by merger (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)
Application in Swedish or English (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)
Max one application per call (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)
Klarmarkerad before 12 Jan 2027 14:00, re-mark after unlocking (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)
Registered employer at Skatteverket or notification shown when salaries funded (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)
Not insolvent, in liquidation or reconstruction; no significant unpaid debts at Kronofogden (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)
Project leader employed by the applicant (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)
AB must not have consumed half or more of share capital (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)
Vinnova may require proof of financial coverage, D&B credit report (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)
Project starts 23-30 Mar 2027, max nine months (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)

Only costs incurred within the project period are eligible; the Nordiq ML-ops order Nov 2026-Jan 2027 cannot be a project cost (https://www.vinnova.se/globalassets/huvudsajt/sok-finansiering/regler-och-villkor/dokument/svenska/allmanna-villkor-2026---en-part.pdf ; https://www.vinnova.se/globalassets/huvudsajt/sok-finansiering/regler-och-villkor/dokument/svenska/anvisning-till-villkor_om_stodberattigande_kostnader-2026.pdf)

Salary costs only if actually paid, time-recorded, no unjustified salary rise (https://www.vinnova.se/globalassets/huvudsajt/sok-finansiering/regler-och-villkor/dokument/svenska/anvisning-till-villkor_om_stodberattigande_kostnader-2026.pdf)

Consultants external at market terms; all consultant and licence costs justified and scored (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/ ; https://www.vinnova.se/globalassets/huvudsajt/sok-finansiering/regler-och-villkor/dokument/svenska/anvisning-till-villkor_om_stodberattigande_kostnader-2026.pdf)
Indirect costs actual and max 30 % of salary costs (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)
Grant max SEK 500,000 at up to 100 % (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/)

Gender equality integrated: team balance, gender perspective form field, strategy for equal power (https://www.vinnova.se/e/innovativa-startups/innovativa-startups-2026/ ; https://www.vinnova.se/sok-finansiering/sa-har-fyller-du-i-ansokan/)
